summary: Adversarial re-check of the 'surfaces' research as of 2026-11-06. About 60% of concrete claims verify against fetched primary pages. Corrections: (1) Bypass permissions is not limited to Pro/Max/Ultra; Team and Enterprise are governed by org policy. (2) Dispatch lives in Cowork, not the Code tab. (3) The Remote Control v2.1.304 requirement applies only to Desktop with DISABLE_TELEMETRY or DO_NOT_TRACK set. (4) The Team/Enterprise scheduled-task toggle has the label 'Scheduled tasks (Was Routines)' at claude.ai/admin-settings/capabilities. (5) The Slack legacy retirement (2026-10-05) is already in effect today, and Team/Enterprise should use Claude Tag, which the Slack item omits. (6) Cmd+Esc is the VS Code shortcut, not confirmed for JetBrains. Unverifiable: Cowork plan tiers and all release-note dates (support.claude.com was not re-fetched), Cowork Projects and Dispatch flow, Desktop Browser pane clean-profile claim, Trusted Devices beta details, JetBrains specifics, and the claim that Slack sessions can be teleported. Missing for a non-developer site: a plan-by-feature matrix (feature-availability.md, referenced by the mobile and quickstart pages but not fetched); Projects in Claude Code cloud (claude-projects.md) and Cowork; Dispatch details (desktop page, dispatch.md); Claude in Chrome and Channels (Telegram, Discord, iMessage, channels.md) as mobile-to-machine options; Computer use (computer-use.md); Code Review and Ultrareview; the platforms.md 'work away from terminal' comparison; and the terminal-guide page for absolute beginners. Key missing caveat: the Desktop Auto mode availability conditions (API only, specific model versions).
